properties.site-address: Former Nicholls Transport site, Lydbrook Close, Sittingbourne
properties.notes: The site was granted planning permission in 2001 and remains extant due to early trench digging. Application 17/503888/OUT was recently withdrawn in favour of building out the previous application.. Approval of Reserved Matters for Residential Development Pursuant to Outline Planning Permission SW/97/0623 (49 dwellings).. The site comprises the former Nicholls Transport depot which has now been vacant for a number of years and is surrounded by dwellings close to the A2.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
